newsitem.title: USA: Owens & Minor CFO resigns, Rector promoted.
newsitem.headline: Owens & Minor CFO resigns, Rector promoted.

text.p: Owens & Minor Inc said on Wednesday its chief financial officer, Glenn Dozier, was resigning, effective September 6, to pursue other interests.
Ann Greer Rector, currently vice president and controller, has been promoted to senior vice president and chief financial officer. She will assume those duties on September 9, 1996.
In addition, F. Thomas Smiley, vice president, operations and cost management, will leave the company effective September 27, Owens & Minor said.

Owens & Minor said Rector would assume Smiley's cost-management duties while his operations duties would be assumed by James Grigg. Grigg was given the title senior vice president, supply chain management.
